g.title:
Before designing WayBuddy, I wanted to understand how people currently navigate unfamiliar destinations using public transportation, the challenges they encounter, and how existing navigation tools fit into their journeys.
I conducted a quantitative survey to understand these behaviors and identify opportunities for a better public transport navigation experience.
WHAT I WANTED TO FIND OUT
How do people find their way when travelling somewhere unfamiliar?
What makes navigating by public transport difficult?
What apps or methods do people currently rely on?
Are people aware of its public transport navigation feature?
For people who use the feature, how easy or difficult is it to navigate with?
